params.body:
## What Ilse saw

On Eigen wagenpark, the "Gepubliceerd" column read **"Al 0 dagen"** for a vehicle she had published that morning.

## Why

`available_on_stocklist_date` is a date without a time. The row compared it with the current moment: at noon that is a negative fraction of a day, so the sign chose "al" (already) and the rounded count was 0. The `fromToday` branch only fired at exactly midnight.

## Change

- `Vehicle::stocklistDaysDelta()` counts **whole calendar days** (start of day to start of day) and returns an int; `stocklistDays()` is its absolute value. The row partial reads the model instead of its own inline Carbon copy (93-logica item 21, now done).
- Today reads **"Vanaf vandaag"**; one day is singular: **"Al 1 dag"**, **"Binnen 1 dag"**; otherwise "Al N dagen" / "Binnen N dagen". New `trans_choice` keys `global.on_stocklist_since_days` and `global.on_stocklist_in_days` in nl, fr, en, de (`LanguageParityTest` green).
- Unpublished vehicles are untouched: they keep the funnel button (publish, stock, inspection, trade price) or "Niet op stocklist" (in option / sold).
- Rule S2-2.5 updated with the calendar-day and singular wording.

## Test

`tests/Feature/OwnStockRowPublishedDaysTest.php` renders the row at a fixed 14:30 for a vehicle published today, yesterday, five days ago, tomorrow, in three days, and unpublished (button and "Niet op stocklist"). It fails on the previous partial with "Al 0 dagen".

Ran: OwnStockRowPublishedDaysTest, LanguageParityTest, OwnFleetTextTest, CompiledViewsTest, OwnStockRowMarkupTest, FrenchTranslationsTest, ViewLogicHelpersTest, RulesCoverageTest, RulesIdentityTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest, AlpineExpressionTest, HandlerWiringTest (55 tests, 1062 assertions, 1 pre-existing incomplete); SmokeTest filtered on ownvehicle (38 tests).

Verified in the browser at 1440 and 390 px: "Vanaf vandaag", "Al 1 dag", "Al 5 dagen".

Note for merge sequencing: this touches the shared row partial `resources/views/ownstock/_wagen_rij.blade.php` (the days cell only).
params.title: Own fleet: a vehicle published today says 'vanaf vandaag' instead of 'al 0 dagen'
